title: Exceptional pullback bounds on the lisse stratum
statement: Let k, l≠p and A=O_E/(ϖ_E^(n+1)) be as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let X be a separated finite-type k-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] with topological dimension at most d_X∈N, g:Z→X a closed immersion and j:S→Z an open immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let M be a bounded constructible complex of A-modules on X_et with Tor amplitude in [a,b] [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Then N=j^* Rg^! M, with Rg^! the right adjoint of the closed direct image [lem-exc-closed-ambient], is bounded constructible on S with Tor amplitude in [a,b+2d_X+1].

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: A has invertible exponent on Spec k [lem-coef-etale-lisse-hom-coefficient-invertible-exponent], and X is Noetherian because it is quasi-compact and locally of finite type over a field.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: Apply [thm-pur-open-complement-unconditional] to the open complement h:X∖Z→X with bound d_X: R^qh_* vanishes for q>2d_X and preserves constructibility. Then [prop-exc-closed-tor] with c=2d_X gives Rg^!M bounded constructible with Tor amplitude in [a,b+2d_X+1]; uniqueness of right adjoints identifies it with the chosen right adjoint.

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: The open restriction j^* is exact, preserves constructibility and commutes with derived tensor products, so N keeps both properties and the interval.
